OpcodeSavepoint.doc: Savepoint-control opcodes. Each carries an owned savepoint name. Execution delegates to the storage savepoint stack — the VDBE itself holds no savepoint state. Outcome is Continue or Halt(Error(condition)); never Jump.

Savepoint.doc: Push a new savepoint frame named `name` onto the storage savepoint stack. If no transaction is open, the storage layer silently begins one (storage pin S2). Halts with SavepointStackOverflow if the stack is at SAVEPOINT_STACK_MAX_DEPTH.

ReleaseSavepoint.doc: Discard the savepoint named `name` and every frame above it. Changes from discarded frames are merged into the next-outer frame, or committed to the outer transaction if the released frame was outermost. Halts with SavepointNotFound if no matching frame is on the stack.

RollbackToSavepoint.doc: Revert all changes (page + schema) made since the savepoint named `name` was declared. The matched frame STAYS on the stack; frames above it are discarded along with their reverted changes. Halts with SavepointNotFound if no matching frame is on the stack.

execute.doc: Execute one savepoint opcode by delegating to the storage SavepointStore. Returns Continue on success or Halt(Error(SavepointNotFound | SavepointStackOverflow)) on failure.
